subject: soc-rt-dy
title: SOC.RT.DY.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 462 (TRF(CW)-34). SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the subject; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and CULT-INFO-OS. From T-C-IMP: OBS (observation). From OBS: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From VT-DY: PER-DY (perception dynamics). From PER-DY: ROTP (responsibility of the position). From ROTP: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From CULT-INFO-OS: MT-RT-SIGN and PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies). From MT-RT-SIGN: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics).
